scope: Focused deterministic DOM/Node journey follow-up after release 61; real source handler/module execution with explicit native Escape/cancel modeling. No production network, fake users, payments or physical browser.

findings.trigger: Fullscreen feed → real separate payment/map/voice/local-AI/support dialog → Escape.
findings.before: The document key handler exited the feed when #modal was closed, while a separate dialog was still open.
findings.after: The root-owned handler respects defaultPrevented and every open dialog; native Escape closes only the current layer.

findings.trigger: Tap photo → 320ms delay → another dialog opens and closes before timeout → original top dialog is current again.
findings.before: The old photo request passed the top-dialog identity check and unexpectedly opened after the other interaction.
findings.after: Dialog close/cancel captures cancel the pending tap and release warmed media; a new explicit tap still works.

tests.output: PASS: Escape closes real payment/map/voice/local-AI/support overlays without leaving the feed; prevented/bare-feed/main-modal routes stay correct, and close/cancel interrupts stale deferred photo opens while retaining normal taps, favorites and underlying state. Browser/device behavior is not asserted.

PASS: one tapped original warms during the unchanged 320ms favorite window, is adopted without duplicate request node, preserves logical crops/full resolution and background context, and cancels on double-tap/scroll/drag/hide/close/stale overlay.

PASS: trusted fullscreen photo-only gallery, bounded native-pan zoom, delayed tap/double-favorite priority, keyboard/Escape/Back, swipe/ghost/multitouch guards, stale callbacks and exact underlying lot/feed position preservation.
PASS: stale/closed/replaced/cancelled location callbacks, overlapping GPS requests, valid/invalid positions, modal/background/reduced-motion video playback.
